Name: Year 1 Pirate's Wife Quest
Author: AirynS
Description:
A very quick, simple mod born of a discussion on the main SDV Discord server, this mod simply makes it possible to complete the Pirate's Wife sidequest in Year 1 by giving Jodi the war memento instead of Kent. She will accept it (with new dialogue) and give you the gourmet tomato salt as Kent would.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] Year 1 Pirate's Wife Quest" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9242]Ginger Island NPC Overhaul[/url]'s edits to the Pirate's Wife quest! Portrait mod used in the screenshot is Diverse Stardew Valley.

Thanks to Wizadroid for the idea prompt and Atravita for the knowledge of how to create this mod.
